title: Hydrating!
description: Adds a texture fix to the hydro class scrolls for Hazen and Stuff 1.4.0
body:
Made for [Hazen 'n Stuff](https://modrinth.com/mod/hazen-n-stuff) to fix an issue from the 1.4.0 update, adding a selection of spells in the "Hydro" class. This fixes the missing texture, using the guardian's color palette as inspiration.

Thank you to [Hazezntouvel](https://modrinth.com/user/Hazezntouvel) for making such an awesome mod!
